payload.title: File:Edmontosaurus species scale diagram.png
payload.description_html:
Diagram showing the size of Edmontosaurus regalis and Edmontosaurus annectens.
  • E. annectens body by SpinoInWonderland https://thesauropodomorphlair.wordpress.com/2021/02/10/size-of-the-duck-titans/
  • E. annectens size: Morris, William J. (1970). "Hadrosaurian dinosaur bills — morphology and function". Contributions in Science (Los Angeles County Museum of Natural History). 193: 1–14.
  • E. regalis body by Scott Hartman https://www.skeletaldrawing.com/ornithiscians
  • E. regalis size: Lull, Richard Swann; and Wright, Nelda E. (1942). Hadrosaurian Dinosaurs of North America.
  • Human silhouette: File:Paleontologist silhouette.png
